nextGame.note: Saturday morning kickoff at West Point.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure is back for the Army game
news.summary: McClure hurt his left foot in August and has not played all season. Tulane expects its best running back on the field Saturday at Army.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff. It is homecoming at Florida.

news.headline: Sumrall says South Carolina has the most talent yet
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said South Carolina is the best group of players Florida has faced this year, even though the Gamecocks have lost three games. They come to Florida on Saturday for homecoming.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III is cleared to practice again
news.summary: The Florida receiver hurt his knee against Ole Miss and missed the loss at Missouri. Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that Brown can run and practice, but he is not sure yet whether Brown plays Saturday against South Carolina.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh apologizes to his coach
news.summary: The Florida running back sent coach Jon Sumrall a text message Sunday to say he was sorry for how he played in the 45-17 loss at Missouri. Baugh carried the ball 12 times for 13 yards in that game.

nextGame.note: The Red River game against Oklahoma, played in Dallas.

news.headline: Oklahoma's coach calls Arch Manning a great player
news.summary: Brent Venables said Manning has a cannon for an arm and no weaknesses in his game. The two teams play Saturday afternoon in Dallas.

news.headline: Texas is healthier after its week off
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday the Longhorns are healthier than they were a week ago. Texas did not play last weekend and meets Oklahoma in Dallas on Saturday.

news.headline: Arch Manning turns up at a middle school game
news.summary: With Texas off this week, Manning went to a middle school football game in Austin on Monday night and spent time with the players. Texas is 4-0 and plays Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in the Superdome. Minnesota has won all four of its games.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara sits out practice with a sore back
news.summary: Kamara did not practice on Wednesday because his back is sore. Coach Kellen Moore said the knee that bothered Kamara on Monday night was checked and is fine.

news.headline: Tyler Shough does not practice with a hurt hand
news.summary: The Saints quarterback hurt his left hand in Monday night's loss and did not practice on Wednesday. Chris Olave, Kaden Elliss and Barion Brown also sat out.

news.headline: Minnesota is not sure Justin Jefferson can play
news.summary: Jefferson is the Vikings' best receiver and he has a sprained ankle. Their coach said Tuesday the ankle is getting better but would not promise he plays Sunday in New Orleans.

tv.name: PSAC Sports Digital Network
tv.note: Every IUP volleyball game is on the PSAC Sports Digital Network. The app is free to get on Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, iPhone or Android, or just tap here on game day. Edinboro is the home team, so this match plays on their channel.

nextGame.note: Friday evening match at Edinboro. Five o'clock our time, six o'clock theirs.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP loses in five sets and its streak ends
news.summary: Pitt-Johnstown won the fifth set 15-11 on Saturday in Johnstown to take the match 3-2. It is IUP's first loss since August, after 11 wins in a row, and the Crimson Hawks are now 12-4.

news.headline: IUP sweeps California for its 11th win in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-18, 25-20, 25-23 at home on Friday. Jessica Neiman had 14 kills and Delaney Concannon had 13 kills and 14 digs, and IUP is 12-3 and still unbeaten in the conference.

news.headline: Tampa Bay beats the Yankees 4-3 and ends their season
news.summary: Tampa Bay won Wednesday night at Yankee Stadium to take the series three games to none. The Yankees are out of the playoffs, and it is 17 years since they last won the World Series.

news.headline: A fan reaches over the wall and takes away a home run
news.summary: Anthony Volpe hit a ball to left field in the sixth inning that would have tied the game at 4-4. A fan leaned over the wall and caught it, so the umpires gave Volpe a double instead and only one run scored.

news.headline: Aaron Judge says the Yankees should go all in
news.summary: Judge strained a calf in September and watched the whole playoff series from the dugout. He said afterward that the team should go all in and add players for next year.

nextGame.note: Thursday night home game at Pan American Stadium in City Park, and a district game. It was moved up from Saturday afternoon because a tropical storm is coming. Saint Augustine and Holy Cross play there first at 3:00, so this is the second game of the night.

news.headline: Warren Easton's game moves up to Thursday night
news.summary: The Eagles now host Higgins on Thursday at 7:30 at Pan American Stadium instead of Saturday afternoon. It was moved because a tropical storm may reach southeast Louisiana this weekend.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins its first game, 50-0
news.summary: The Eagles shut out Riverdale 50-0 on Thursday in Jefferson for their first win of the year. Warren Easton is now 1-4.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.
